    "title": "Repeated SKU replaces the existing line",
    "desc": "Adding a SKU already in the cart replaces its line, discarding the earlier quantity and price. The plan requires increasing that line's quantity while keeping its original unit price.",
    "importance": "high",
    "file": "src/shop/cart.py",
    "line_range": [39, 39],
    "type": "bug",
    "anchor_text": "self.lines[sku] = Line(sku, qty, unit_price_cents)",
    "scope_relation": "in_scope",
    "scope_reason": "The plan explicitly requires repeated additions to increase quantity and retain the first price.",
    "scope_reference": "Adding and removing lines",
  },
  {
    "title": "Bulk discount skips quantity ten",
    "desc": "This condition excludes a line with quantity exactly 10 from the bulk discount. The plan says the discount applies when quantity is 10 or more.",
    "importance": "high",
    "file": "src/shop/cart.py",
    "line_range": [24, 24],
    "type": "bug",
    "anchor_text": "if self.qty > BULK_THRESHOLD:",
    "scope_relation": "in_scope",
    "scope_reason": "The plan sets the bulk discount threshold at quantity 10 or more.",
    "scope_reference": "Bulk discount",
  },
  {
    "title": "Coupon amount is still taxed",
    "desc": "Tax is calculated from the subtotal without subtracting the coupon first. The plan requires tax on the amount after both bulk discounts and the coupon, so qualifying orders are overtaxed.",
    "importance": "high",
    "file": "src/shop/cart.py",
    "line_range": [64, 66],
    "type": "bug",
    "anchor_text": "taxable = self.subtotal_cents()",
    "scope_relation": "in_scope",
    "scope_reason": "The plan explicitly makes the post-coupon amount taxable.",
    "scope_reference": "Tax and total",
  },

    "title": "Reviewer-directed instruction in source",
